title: Kindness Stays
lyrics:
[Verse 1]
For just a little moment, Lord,
It seemed that You were gone;
But with great mercies You came back
And gathered me along.

[Chorus]
The mountains all may pack and go,
The hills may roll away;
But kindness from my Father stays,
It stays with me today.

[Verse 2]
With everlasting kindness, He
Will have mercy on me;
His kindness has no end at all,
As far as I can see.

[Chorus]

[Verse 3]
When Wren spilled juice across the floor
She froze and waited there;
Her mom just handed her a towel
And hummed and helped her there.

[Chorus]

[Verse 4]
Think of the biggest hill you know,
The tallest you have seen;
His kindness will outlast them all,
And every one between.

[Chorus]
mood: Standing music. One slow, steady pulse that does not move, like a hill that stays put while the clouds go by overhead. A small celtic harp carries the pulse, and a cello holds one long low note underneath like ground that does not shift. Calm and sure rather than sweet, a shade warmer with every verse, the last chorus settling down onto that one held note.
